reviews.text: Was great until ads. I really do enjoy the sound and at first I could play it all night without interruption. Seems like after a month ads pop up and stop it randomly. The ads almost seem like it would be a virus too. The most common one claiming that “72 malicious viruses have been detected on my device” they want you to click on it to continue but it isn’t true.
Ads. every time i open the app i get a ad but other then that it is good
Ads wake you up. Ads with loud sounds wake you up in the middle of the night!!

I was liking this app and then…. Tonight I’m trying to fall asleep with it per usual, after using this for a month. Now ads keep popping up and stopping the app all together. If it at least kept playing, even if those popped up it might be ok but I’ve had to restart it twice within 20 mins.
Bntr. I was so energetic last night then I put this on and fell asleep in a snap
Brown noise. The brown noise is literally a hug when I’m over stimulated . Also the only sound that tunes out hubby’s snoring . Win win for me .
Perfect and simple Functionality and UI. Start and run any top noise, my preference is brown. Has a timer. Add support, skippable in 10 seconds. Allowed sleeping during a noisy hotel stay

Finally!. Didn’t expect it
Great dreams, deep sleep

I love it!. I sleep so much deeper and all through the night! This app is so easy to use! I definitely recommend!
Wonderful. Free and few adds!!

Best sleep app simple pink noise. I had this app on android. I’ve used it for literally ever. My only thing is I want to buy it so that I can pay you back for all the great work you have done. Where is the function where I can spend money. For no ads?

Easy Effective. Very simple. Why would someone pay for something else?

Exactly what a noise app should be.. This app is great! Totally free, limited ads, and there is no time limit on how long you can play a noise. A lot of other apps only let you play it for 8 hours, otherwise you have to pay. Still others have a lot of ads that can defeat the purpose of a noise machine app. 

We use this any time we are traveling or camping. A simply unbeatable app! Well done!
Timer Defective. I pushed the button for the timer and set it for 30 minutes but never saw a place to start it. Then I couldn’t get rid of it. Frustrating.

Finally O didn’t have to pay. Excellent app. The only one that gives me three noise options and I didn’t have to pay for it. I do t need 200 different noises including the sound of an earthworm as it moves through the ground. Just give me some fuzzy background noise so I can sleep. This one delivered

Good noise app. Super simple, straightforward noise app. No loops, which I always notice and which always drive me bananas. Definitely prefer the brown (to pink or white) for sleeping. Sounds like a fan.
